meta.title: Optimize string operations
meta.body_summary: Optimize string operations by using write_substring to avoid intermediate allocations, remove unused TODO comments, and update array joining helpers for direct view appends.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex optimizes string operations via write_substring, merged quickly after a bot code review with non-blocking suggestions; no human review or perf evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Very small change (50 lines) across three files, typical of a micro-optimization PR; merged quickly without formal review, consistent with low-risk string library tweak.

review_details.concern_detail: Bot noted that the 'new' parameter in replace_all still uses to_string, missing an opportunity for write_substring, and suggested using write_substring as well.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid creating intermediate strings by using write_substring for string views.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Codex can implement low-level string optimizations using library functions; merge occurred without benchmark or human review, indicating low bar for small core library changes by trusted maintainers.

detection_detail.code_reading: peter-jerry-ye-code-review bot provided detailed static analysis identifying remaining intermediate allocation opportunities, Unicode TODO tracking, and code duplication.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance measurements; only narrative claim and CI pass (formatter/info).

core_change_summary.description: Replace string concatenation and to_string calls with write_substring in string/methods.mbt and update array joining helpers in array/fixedarray.mbt and array/view.mbt to directly append views.
change_trajectory: Single commit 'Use write_substring for string views' modifies three files with total 50 lines changed.

review_signals.summary: Bot identified remaining intermediate allocations in replace_all, Unicode TODO tracking issue, and code duplication between String and View, but suggestions were not blocking.
Coverage report posted after merge indicating 100% coverage of changed lines.

collaboration_trajectory: Bot code-review comment posted ~20 seconds later with non-blocking suggestions
PR merged by author ~41 minutes after creation without addressing bot suggestions
Coveralls posted coverage report after merge
